title: Sensitive data leakage in sklearn.feature_extraction.text.TfidfVectorizer due to storing all unique tokens in stop_words_ attribute
trigger_payload:
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=2).fit(pd.Series(["hello", "world", "hello", "world", "secretkey", "password123"]))
print(vectorizer.vocabulary_)
print(vectorizer.stop_words_)
oracle: The stop_words_ attribute contains sensitive tokens like 'secretkey' and 'password123' that were not part of the final vocabulary, indicating unintended data leakage.
